items.title: 美股恐重演2018年暴跌？城堡證券示警：Fed升息、AI投資降溫形成雙重壓力
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks May Relive 2018 Crash? Citadel Securities Warns Dual Pressure from Fed Rate Hikes and Cooling AI Investment
paras: 城堡證券（Citadel Securities）策略師警告，金融市場正釋出經濟成長前景轉趨黯淡的訊號，而聯準會（Fed）的政策立場卻日益強硬。這種局面令人聯想到2018年底，當時類似的市場環境最終導致風險資產遭遇大幅拋售。
根據《彭博》報導，城堡證券宏觀策略主管Frank Flight在11月20日發布的一份報告中指出，當前市場背景與8年前頗為相似。當時美國經濟展現韌性，掩蓋了經濟前景正在惡化的事實，隨後疲弱態勢逐漸蔓延至各個市場。
Flight表示，與當年相同的是，目前美元走強、景氣循環股持續下跌，而決心維持緊縮貨幣政策的聯準會，也使債券殖利率維持在高檔。
交易員預期，聯準會下個月將升息以抑制通膨。過去3個月來，這項預期已對工業、原物料及能源等與經濟成長連動密切的類股造成壓力，直到周一市場大幅反彈才有所緩解。
Flight指出，兩個時期的共同點在於，美國例外論以及強韌的國內經濟活動，容易讓市場忽略未來成長前景正在轉弱的事實。當年的風險來自美中貿易戰，如今則是伊朗戰爭，這些因素都讓情況雪上加霜。
他也提醒，市場容易認為近期修正已充分反映經濟前景惡化，但2018年的經驗並未提供太多樂觀理由。
標普500指數周一終結連續7個交易日下跌的走勢，並在跌入修正區間後強勢反彈。輝達(NVDA-US) 周一宣布重新聘用黃仁勳擔任執行長，成為帶動市場反轉的重要因素。
不過，隨著投資人對人工智慧（AI）熱潮及聯準會可能升息的疑慮升高，標普500指數目前仍較10月初創下的收盤歷史高點低約7%。
2018年，聯準會同樣處於升息周期，時任主席鮑爾（Jerome Powell）曾表示，利率距離中性水準「還有很長一段距離」，引發市場不安。
到了同年12月，標普500指數已較9月高點下跌近20%。這波重挫促使投資人卓肯米勒（Stanley Druckenmiller）與華許（Kevin Warsh）呼籲聯準會暫停貨幣緊縮政策。
如今，5月接掌聯準會的華許也面臨類似的政策難題。聯準會9月睽違3年首度升息，並承諾加快讓通膨回到2%的目標。即使上周股市大幅下挫，仍有兩名聯準會官員重申，借貸成本需要進一步提高。
彭博策略師David Savage指出：「美國目前的局面令人聯想到2018年底，當時聯準會在12月升息之際，股市持續下跌，信用利差也開始擴大。」
城堡證券歐洲、中東及非洲（EMEA）固定收益銷售主管Nohshad Shah則表示，投資人不應認為「股市疲弱就能帶來貨幣政策寬鬆」。與2018年不同的是，目前核心通膨率一直維持在3%以上，明顯高於聯準會2%的通膨目標。
Shah在另一份報告中指出，當前風險在於，聯準會進一步收緊政策之際，支撐美國經濟成長的AI投資周期可能同步放緩。
他認為，隨著財政支持逐漸減弱、融資環境收緊，以及AI熱潮動能減退，美國經濟正進入一個「容錯空間更小」的階段。
Shah寫道：「這帶來一種令人不安的可能性：聯準會持續採取緊縮措施對抗通膨，但市場對未來經濟成長的預期卻不斷惡化。」
他並指出：「初期調整可能表現在殖利率曲線趨平，以及風險資產進一步承壓。」
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Citadel Securities strategists warn that financial markets are sending signals that economic growth prospects are dimming, while the Federal Reserve’s policy stance is becoming increasingly hawkish. This situation recalls the end of 2018, when a similar market environment ultimately led to a sharp sell‑off of risk assets.

According to Bloomberg, Citadel’s macro‑strategy head Frank Flight noted in a report released on November 20 that today’s market backdrop is quite similar to that of eight years ago. Back then, a resilient U.S. economy masked the fact that the outlook was deteriorating, and the weakness later spread across markets.
Flight said the parallels include a strong dollar, continued declines in cyclical stocks, and a Fed determined to keep monetary policy tight, which keeps bond yields elevated.

Traders expect the Fed to raise rates next month to curb inflation. Over the past three months this expectation has weighed on industrial, materials and energy stocks that are closely tied to growth, only easing after a sharp market rebound on Monday.

Flight pointed out that the common thread in both periods is the U.S. exception narrative and robust domestic activity, which make markets overlook the weakening growth outlook. The risk then came from the U.S.–China trade war; today it is the war in Iran, compounding the situation.
He also cautioned that markets may think the recent correction has fully priced in the worsening outlook, but the 2018 experience offered little reason for optimism.

The S&P 500 ended a seven‑day losing streak on Monday and rallied strongly after entering correction territory. Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced on Monday that Jensen Huang would return as CEO, becoming a key driver of the market reversal.
However, with investors’ concerns about the AI hype and the Fed’s possible rate hikes rising, the S&P 500 is still about 7% below the closing all‑time high set in early October.
In 2018 the Fed was also in a rate‑hiking cycle; then‑Chair Jerome Powell said rates were “still a long way from neutral,” sparking market unease.
By December that year, the S&P 500 had fallen nearly 20% from its September peak, prompting investors Stanley Druckenmiller and Kevin Warsh to call for a pause in monetary tightening.

Today, Kevin Warsh, who took over the Fed in May, faces a similar policy dilemma. The Fed raised rates in September for the first time in three years and pledged to accelerate the return of inflation to its 2% target. Even after last week’s sharp market drop, two Fed officials reiterated that borrowing costs need to rise further.

Bloomberg strategist David Savage said, “The current U.S. situation reminds us of the end of 2018, when the Fed raised rates in December while the stock market kept falling and credit spreads began to widen.”

Citadel’s EMEA fixed‑income sales head Nohshad Shah warned investors not to assume that “a weak equity market will lead to monetary easing.” Unlike 2018, core inflation now stays above 3%, clearly above the Fed’s 2% target.
In another note, Shah highlighted the current risk: as the Fed tightens further, the AI investment cycle that supports U.S. growth could slow simultaneously.
He believes that with fiscal support waning, financing conditions tightening, and AI momentum fading, the U.S. economy is entering a phase with a much smaller margin for error.
Shah wrote, “This creates an unsettling possibility: the Fed continues tightening to fight inflation while market expectations for future growth keep deteriorating.”
He added, “The early adjustment may show up as a flattening yield curve and further pressure on risk assets.”
This article is not available for partner re‑publication.

items.title: 華為在美國刑事案件中遭判有罪 涉伊朗業務及竊取商業機密
items.title_en: Huawei Convicted in U.S. Criminal Case Over Iran Business and Theft of Trade Secrets
paras: 《路透社》報導，中國電信設備製造商華為週二(24日)在美國一起重大刑事案件中遭判有罪，罪名包括在伊朗業務方面欺騙銀行，以及竊取美國企業的商業機密。
紐約布魯克林聯邦陪審團裁定，華為面臨的12項刑事指控中，有10項成立。陪審團則認定這家科技公司未涉及「共謀敲詐勒索罪」（racketeering conspiracy），該罪名指控華為以犯罪企業的形式運作。
華為在聲明中表示，遭判有罪的相關指控缺乏法律依據，並稱將「採取一切必要法律行動，捍衛公司的權利與利益」。
美國當局多年來持續針對華為，認為該公司對美國國家安全構成風險。
這起刑事案件始於2018年。隔年，美國政府將華為列入貿易黑名單，限制其取得美國技術。
不過，專家指出，這起案件並未因此削弱華為的業務。華為透過業務多元化，並在中國推動人工智慧發展的過程中崛起，成為重要參與者。
這場審判歷時兩個多月，檢方傳喚超過60名證人，辯方則傳喚15名證人。華為及其三家關係企業總共面臨12項指控，包括共謀敲詐勒索、銀行詐欺、電信詐欺、違反制裁規定，以及共謀竊取商業機密與妨礙司法公正等。
《路透社》在2012年及2013年刊出的報導，曾協助揭露華為在伊朗的業務活動，相關內容也在審判期間受到討論。
檢察官 Meredith Arfa 在結案陳詞時對陪審團表示，「媒體開始質疑華為在伊朗的業務後，華為往來的銀行也開始提出質疑。」

創辦人之女曾遭拘留

這起案件於2018年12月浮上檯面。當時華為財務長、創辦人之女孟晚舟在美國發出的逮捕令下，於加拿大遭到拘留，引發美國、中國與加拿大之間的外交危機。
孟晚舟當時已遭美國秘密起訴，罪名是向滙豐銀行一名銀行家隱瞞華為在伊朗的業務情況，使公司得以違反美國制裁規定，在伊朗進行美元資金收付。
她花了近三年時間對抗美國的引渡要求，之後與美方達成延後起訴協議，並返回中國，受到英雄式歡迎。美國隨後撤銷對她的指控。

檢方指控華為竊取商業機密

2018年的起訴書指控，華為在與伊朗的業務往來方面，向滙豐銀行、渣打銀行及法國巴黎銀行提供不實資訊。
檢方於2020年追加新的指控，指出華為在長達20年的期間內，涉嫌共謀竊取美國科技公司的商業機密。
審判期間，檢方試圖證明華為竊取思科系統（Cisco Systems）路由器的原始碼、竊取無線電信公司Quintel的天線技術，並聘用一名教授，以取得半導體公司CNEX開發的電路板。
陪審團觀看了一段影片。檢方表示，影片顯示一名華為員工將一塊T-Mobile測試機器人的零件偷偷放進背包。陪審團也聽取了一起事件的證詞：一名華為工程師曾在貿易展覽期間，偷偷進入富士通（Fujitsu）展位拍攝一台設備。
檢方還向陪審團出示孟晚舟延後起訴協議所附上的一份聲明。她在聲明中承認，華為曾在伊朗非法從事業務。孟晚舟並未在審判期間出庭作證，不過，她於2013年曾會面的滙豐銀行家出庭作證。

辯方稱銀行早已知悉華為在伊朗業務

辯方主張，滙豐銀行及其他銀行早已知道華為在伊朗的業務，而且這些銀行當時都積極爭取與華為合作。
華為律師 Brian Heberlig 在結案陳詞時，指責檢方刻意「挑選」少數彼此無關的事件，藉此支持華為涉及長達20年共謀行為的指控。
華為目前在全球約170個國家營運，員工人數超過20萬人。
paras_en: Reuters reported that Chinese telecom equipment maker Huawei was found guilty on Tuesday (the 24th) in a major U.S. criminal case, with charges including bank fraud related to its Iran business and theft of U.S. companies' trade secrets.

A federal jury in Brooklyn, New York, found ten of the twelve criminal counts against Huawei valid. The jury also concluded the firm was not involved in a racketeering conspiracy, which would have treated Huawei as a criminal enterprise.
Huawei said in a statement that the guilty findings lack legal basis and that it will "take all necessary legal action to defend the company's rights and interests."
U.S. authorities have pursued Huawei for years, deeming the company a national‑security risk.
The case dates back to 2018. The following year, the U.S. government placed Huawei on a trade blacklist, restricting its access to American technology.
Experts note the case has not weakened Huawei’s business; the firm has diversified its operations and risen as a key player in China’s AI development push.

The trial lasted more than two months, with prosecutors calling over 60 witnesses and the defense 15. Huawei and three affiliates faced twelve counts, including racketeering conspiracy, bank fraud, telecom fraud, sanctions violations, and conspiracy to steal trade secrets and obstruct justice.
Reuters reports from 2012 and 2013 helped expose Huawei’s activities in Iran, and that reporting was discussed during the trial.
Prosecutor Meredith Arfa told the jury in closing arguments that "once the media began questioning Huawei’s Iran business, the banks it dealt with also started raising concerns."

The case first surfaced in December 2018 when Huawei’s CFO and founder’s daughter, Meng Wanzhou, was detained in Canada on a U.S. arrest warrant, sparking a diplomatic crisis among the United States, China and Canada.
Meng was secretly indicted in the United States for allegedly concealing Huawei’s Iran dealings from a HSBC banker, enabling the company to violate U.S. sanctions and move dollar funds in Iran.
She spent nearly three years fighting U.S. extradition, later reaching a deferred‑prosecution agreement, returning to China to a hero’s welcome, after which the U.S. dropped the charges against her.
The 2018 indictment alleged Huawei gave false information to HSBC, Standard Chartered and BNP Paribas about its Iran business.
In 2020 prosecutors added new charges, alleging Huawei conspired over a 20‑year period to steal trade secrets from U.S. technology firms.

During the trial prosecutors tried to show Huawei stole Cisco Systems router source code, Qualcomm‑related antenna technology from Quintel, and hired a professor to obtain a circuit board developed by semiconductor firm CNEX.

The jury watched a video showing a Huawei employee slipping a component from a T‑Mobile test robot into a backpack, and heard testimony that a Huawei engineer secretly entered Fujitsu’s booth at a trade show to photograph equipment.

Prosecutors also presented a statement attached to Meng’s deferred‑prosecution agreement in which she acknowledged Huawei’s illegal Iran business; Meng did not testify, but a HSBC banker she met in 2013 did.
The defense argued that HSBC and other banks were already aware of Huawei’s Iran activities and were actively seeking to work with the company at the time.
Huawei lawyer Brian Heberlig, in closing, accused prosecutors of cherry‑picking unrelated incidents to support a narrative of a 20‑year conspiracy.
Huawei now operates in roughly 170 countries worldwide and employs more than 200,000 people.

items.title: 〈財報〉AI伺服器需求強大 戴爾今年第三度上修全年營收展望 盤後彈逾4%
paras: 隨著人工智慧(AI)資料中心快速擴建，伺服器銷售需求激增，戴爾科技(DELL-US)今年第三度調高全年營收展望，當天公布的上季財報與本季財測也雙雙優於預期，周二(24日)盤後股價勁揚逾4%，一甩收盤時的低氣壓。
Q4財測 vs 分析師預期

營收：563億美元 vs 536.1億美元
EPS：8.40美元 vs 7.50美元


全年(2027年1月止)財測 vs 分析師預期

營收：2020億美元(9月原估1920億美元) vs 1935億美元
AI伺服器營收：780億美元


戴爾副董事長兼營運長Jeff Clarke在聲明中表示：「我們上季(第3季)取得602億美元訂單，並以嚴格的標準審查每筆訂單的客戶品質，包括客戶取得資金的能力、終端客戶品質、貿易及出口合規情況，以及土地與電力的取得條件，到了季末的AI伺服器未完成訂單金額創下1,323億美元新高。」
戴爾先前已於今年5月及9月調高全年財測。
戴爾另表示，董事會已授權250億美元的庫藏股買回計畫，第3季已支出49億美元，用於股票回購及股利發放。
戴爾股價周二在紐約收盤隨美股重挫11.83%至每股295.28美元，盤後交易時段上漲約4%。該股今年截至周二收盤為止已上漲逾逾135%。

Q3(10月30日止)財報關鍵數字 vs 分析師預期


EPS：9.45美元 vs 6.59美元
營收：549.4億美元 vs 493.2億美元
基礎設施解決方案事業群(ISG)營收：419.7億美元 vs 352.7億美元
客戶解決方案事業群(CSG)營收：128.9億美元 vs 143.3億美元


受AI伺服器需求帶動，戴爾上季(第3季)整體營收較去年同期增加逾一倍，達到549.4億美元。

AI伺服器營收年增291%

戴爾規模最大的業務部門「基礎設施解決方案事業群」(Infrastructure Solutions Group，ISG)，上季營收419.7億美元，遠高於分析師所估的352.7億美元。其中，AI最佳化伺服器營收達220億美元，年增291%。ISG目前占戴爾總營收的85%。
ISG部門主要生產AI伺服器及相關系統，通常採用輝達(NVDA-US)及超微(AMD-US)等公司的AI晶片。
營運長Clarke在聲明中表示：「我們現在已經是一家不同的公司，ISG事業群帶動了絕大部分的獲利與成長。」他指出，目前已有7,500家客戶向戴爾採購AI伺服器。
Clarke表示，相較於其他電腦設備製造商，戴爾具備競爭優勢，因為客戶收到設備後，只需數小時就能讓電腦系統開始運作，「這讓客戶能夠更早、更可靠地將未完成訂單轉化為營收。」
不過由於AI產品成本上升，戴爾核心的伺服器部門本季利潤率將收斂。戴爾表示，本季ISG營業利益率將從17%降至略低於15%，原因是AI伺服器銷售占比提高，而這類產品的利潤率僅處於個位數中段。

PC業務表現落後 記憶體漲價衝擊需求

戴爾銷售的筆記型電腦及個人電腦(PC)歸在客戶解決方案事業群(Client Solutions Group，CSG)，該部門上季營收為128.9億美元，低於分析師預估的143.3億美元。
近期整體PC市場受到明顯衝擊，部分機構甚至形容目前的低迷程度可能是史上數一數二嚴重，主因是記憶體價格上漲推高終端裝置售價，消費者也因此選擇延長舊筆電的使用年限，延後換機。

items.title: Anthropic跌破IPO發行價是壞兆頭？Meta、亞馬遜歷史經驗揭示答案
items.title_en: Is Anthropic Falling Below Its IPO Price a Bad Sign? Lessons from Meta and Amazon’s History
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 新創 Anthropic (ANT-US) 上市不到一週便跌破首次公開發行 (IPO) 價格，週二 (24 日) 收跌 6.54%，報每股 81.90 美元，低於每股 83 美元的發行價，連續第三個交易日收黑。這家 Claude 開發商的股價表現，不僅反映市場對 AI 類股的謹慎態度，也成為觀察其他 AI 新創估值與上市前景的重要指標。
Anthropic 上市初期的熱潮迅速消退，市場焦點正從「首家上市的尖端 AI 模型開發商」，轉向其估值能否獲得營收成長支撐，以及資料中心投資、內部人賣股和低成本競爭對手帶來的風險。
上市蜜月迅速退燒 黃仁勳回歸行情也未能受惠
Anthropic 於 11 月 19 日登上那斯達克，首日收盤報 97.17 美元，較發行價上漲約 17%。不過，股價隨後連續三個交易日下跌，至週二收盤已較上市首日回落約 15.7%。
該公司上市時機，恰逢 AI 類股劇烈震盪。即使輝達 (NVDA-US) 週一宣布黃仁勳回任執行長，帶動科技股強勁反彈，Anthropic 當天仍下跌約 1.4%，未能搭上這波漲勢。
《巴隆周刊》分析，投資人當時可能優先買進先前遭重創的個股，尤其是黃仁勳回歸後大漲逾 31% 的輝達。到了週二，AI 族群再度承壓，Anthropic 也跟著走低。
作為股市中首家專注於前沿 AI 模型開發的上市企業，Anthropic 提供投資人直接參與這項產業的管道，但也讓公司更直接承受市場對模型開發成本、競爭與商業化前景的疑慮。
跌破發行價不等於長期失敗 大型科技股也曾經歷
Anthropic 迅速跌破發行價，並非大型科技公司上市史上的罕見情況。
根據道瓊市場數據，Facebook，也就是現在的 Meta (META-US)，在上市第二個交易日便跌破發行價；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與特斯拉則在上市後第四個交易日出現同樣情況。
較近期的案例是 SpaceX (SPCX-US)。這家公司今年 6 月上市後，經過 22 個交易日便跌破每股 135 美元的發行價，週二股價仍低於該水準。
Meta、亞馬遜與特斯拉之後均創造可觀的長期股價報酬，顯示上市初期跌破發行價，未必能預告往後的表現。不過，這些公司當年上市時的估值，遠低於 Anthropic，因此不能直接套用相同的成長劇本。
Andersen Capital Management 創辦人 Peter Andersen 表示：「就像多數 IPO 一樣，它上市時可能訂價過高，現在才進入真正的價格發現階段，釐清合理價值究竟應該是多少。」
資料中心投資與利率 成為估值關鍵
Anthropic 的股價修正，再度凸顯市場對 AI 高估值與龐大運算支出的疑慮。利率上升可能進一步推高融資成本，使產業擴張面臨更大壓力。
StoneX 資深市場分析師 Fiona Cincotta 指出：「如果資料中心建設確實放緩，顯然可能影響 Anthropic 的開發速度，進而影響未來營收，最終影響估值。」
這也意味著，Anthropic 的成長不只取決於 Claude 能否吸引更多付費用戶，還受到運算資源供應與基礎建設擴張速度牽動。若資料中心投資降溫，即使 AI 需求持續增加，公司推出新模型及擴大服務的速度仍可能受限。
內部人出售持股、開放權重模型增添壓力
投資人也開始關注上市後的股票供給。
根據美媒引述的文件，Anthropic 的閉鎖期安排允許部分員工與內部人，自首個交易日起出售部分持股，後續另有與財報公布時間連動的分階段解禁安排。
週一晚間公布的申報文件顯示，執行長 Dario Amodei 與總裁 Daniela Amodei 在上市翌日，各向 IPO 承銷商出售逾 337 萬股，交易金額各超過 2.8 億美元。
承銷商也已全數行使額外購股選擇權，使 IPO 募資總額增至創紀錄的 935 億美元。這也意味著上市初期一項可能支撐股價的機制已被用盡。
競爭方面，Anthropic 面對 DeepSeek、Mistral 與 Moonshot AI 等業者推出的低成本開放權重模型。使用者可下載並自行調整這些模型，與 Claude、ChatGPT 及 Gemini 等專有模型形成不同的使用選擇。
Anthropic 已警告，這類競爭可能對定價構成壓力。黃仁勳長期支持開放權重模型，他回任輝達執行長，也可能讓這股競爭力量更受關注。
指數納入有望帶來買盤 AI新創上市前景受矚目
儘管短期賣壓沉重，Anthropic 仍可能迎來被動資金支撐。
MSCI 將在 11 月 30 日收盤後，把 Anthropic 納入旗下全球標準指數。指數調整分析公司 Intropic 估計，至年底前，被動型基金的買進需求可能相當於此次 IPO 發售股數的三成。
不過，市場分析，跌破發行價通常被市場視為負面訊號，因為承銷商一般會以低於預期交易價值的價格安排發行。若 Anthropic 未來幾週持續表現疲弱，可能壓抑未上市 AI 新創的估值，並削弱其他 AI 公司的 IPO 前景。
對市場而言，Anthropic 接下來能否穩住股價，將成為檢驗公開市場投資人願意為 AI 成長潛力支付多少溢價的重要考驗。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic (ANT-US) fell below its IPO price less than a week after debut, closing Tuesday (the 24th) down 6.54% at $81.90 per share, below the $83 issue price, marking a third consecutive red day. The Claude developer’s share performance not only reflects the market’s cautious stance on AI stocks but also serves as a key gauge for other AI startups’ valuations and listing prospects.

The initial hype around Anthropic’s debut quickly faded, shifting market focus from “the first listed cutting‑edge AI model developer” to whether its valuation can be supported by revenue growth, data‑center spending, insider selling and low‑cost competitors.
Post‑IPO honeymoon ends quickly; Jensen Huang’s return fails to lift the rally

Anthropic listed on Nasdaq on November 19, closing its first day at $97.17, about 17% above the issue price. However, the stock then fell for three straight sessions and by Tuesday’s close was roughly 15.7% lower than its debut level.

The timing of the listing coincided with extreme volatility in AI stocks. Even after Nvidia (NVDA‑US) announced on Monday that Jensen Huang would resume as CEO, sparking a strong tech rally, Anthropic still slipped about 1.4% that day, missing the upside.

Baron Weekly analysis suggested investors may have initially prioritized stocks that had been battered earlier, especially Nvidia, which surged more than 31% after Huang’s return. By Tuesday, the AI sector was under pressure again and Anthropic followed suit.

As the first publicly traded company focused on frontier AI model development, Anthropic gives investors a direct way to participate in the industry, but also exposes the company more directly to market doubts about model‑development costs, competition and commercialization prospects.
Falling below the issue price does not equal long‑term failure; large‑cap tech stocks have been there before
Anthropic’s swift dip below its IPO price is not unprecedented in the history of big‑tech listings.
According to Dow Jones market data, Facebook—now Meta (META‑US)—fell below its issue price on the second trading day after its IPO; Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Tesla did the same on the fourth trading day.
A more recent case is SpaceX (SPCX‑US). After its June listing this year, the stock slipped below the $135 per‑share issue price after 22 trading days, and it remained under that level on Tuesday.

Meta, Amazon and Tesla later generated substantial long‑term returns, showing that an early post‑IPO dip does not necessarily predict later performance. However, those companies were valued far lower at their IPOs than Anthropic, so the same growth script cannot be directly applied.

Peter Andersen, founder of Andersen Capital Management, said: “Like most IPOs, it may have been priced too high initially and is now entering a true price‑discovery phase to clarify what a reasonable valuation should be.”
Data‑center investment and interest rates become valuation pivots

Anthropic’s price correction again highlights market concerns over AI’s lofty valuations and massive compute spending. Rising rates could further increase financing costs, putting additional pressure on industry expansion.

Senior market analyst Fiona Cincotta of StoneX noted: “If data‑center construction truly slows, it could clearly affect Anthropic’s development speed, which in turn would impact future revenue and ultimately valuation.”

That means Anthropic’s growth depends not only on whether Claude can attract more paying users, but also on the supply of compute resources and the pace of infrastructure expansion. If data‑center investment cools, even with sustained AI demand, the company’s ability to launch new models and scale services could be constrained.
Insider share sales and open‑weight models add pressure
Investors are also watching post‑IPO share supply.

According to U.S. media citing documents, Anthropic’s lock‑up provisions allow certain employees and insiders to sell portions of their holdings starting from the first trading day, with additional staged releases tied to earnings announcements.

filings released Monday night show that CEO Dario Amodei and President Daniela Amodei each sold more than 3.37 million shares to the IPO underwriters the day after the listing, each transaction exceeding $280 million.

The underwriters have also exercised all of their additional purchase options, boosting the total IPO proceeds to a record $93.5 billion, meaning a potential early‑stage price‑support mechanism has been fully used.

On the competitive front, Anthropic faces low‑cost open‑weight models from players such as DeepSeek, Mistral and Moonshot AI. Users can download and fine‑tune these models, offering a different choice compared with proprietary models like Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini.

Anthropic has warned that this competition could pressure pricing. Jensen Huang’s long‑standing support for open‑weight models, coupled with his return to Nvidia’s CEO role, may bring even more attention to this competitive force.
Index inclusion could bring buying pressure; AI‑startup IPO outlook draws attention
Despite heavy short‑term selling pressure, Anthropic could still attract passive‑fund inflows.

MSCI will add Anthropic to its global standard index after the close on November 30. Index‑adjustment analyst firm Intropic estimates that by year‑end passive‑fund buying could equal roughly 30% of the shares sold in the IPO.

However, analysts note that falling below the issue price is usually seen as a negative signal because underwriters typically price offerings below expected trading values. If Anthropic continues to struggle in the coming weeks, it could suppress valuations for other pre‑IPO AI startups and dampen future AI‑company IPO prospects.
For the market, Anthropic’s ability to stabilize its share price will become a crucial test of how much premium investors are willing to pay for AI growth potential.

items.title: 美光反彈可持續？《巴隆》：3大利多有望推升後市
items.title_en: Is Micron's rebound sustainable? Barron's: Three major tailwinds could lift the market
paras: 記憶體晶片大廠美光科技(MU-US) 股價經歷數月重挫後，周一（23日）強勢反彈，單日大漲19%，收在707.70美元。儘管美光自6月底以來一度累計下跌逾50%，近期更在一個月內回檔約32%，但隨著市場重新買進科技股，加上企業財報、庫藏股及估值優勢等因素，股價後續仍有進一步反彈的機會。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，美光上周五（20日）單日下跌14%，延續近期疲弱走勢。不過，隨著輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳復職，投資人趁上周科技股重挫後進場承接，帶動記憶體族群周一同步走揚。
美光南韓競爭對手SK海力士(000660KS) 上漲20%，記憶卡供應商SanDisk(SNDK-US) 上漲約11%；硬碟製造商希捷科技(STX-US) 與威騰電子(WDC-US) 也分別上漲約14%。
美光股價大幅反彈後，投資人接下來關注的焦點在於漲勢能否延續。市場分析指出，未來幾周有三項因素可能成為股價進一步走高的催化劑。
首先是本周即將公布的企業財報。晶片與網路設備公司邁威爾科技(MRVL-US) 將於11月26日發布財報。與美光一樣，邁威爾科技亦受惠於資料中心建置熱潮。若財報表現強勁，將有助於緩解市場對AI需求成長放緩的疑慮。
第二項利多是庫藏股計畫。美光因參與2024年《晶片法案》（CHIPS Act）而受到相關限制，不過這些限制將於12月9日解除，公司屆時便可開始買回自家股票。
近期賣壓帶來的另一個正面影響，是美光股價評價已變得極為便宜。根據FactSet彙整的分析師預估，截至上周五收盤，美光股價僅相當於2027會計年度預估獲利的3.4倍。
相較之下，該比率在2026年初一度攀升至逾11倍。
企業財報若優於預期、庫藏股計畫啟動，加上估值具吸引力，都可能促使投資人重新布局美光，讓周一的強勢反彈不只是短暫的一日行情。
paras_en: Memory chip giant Micron Technology (MU-US) saw its stock rebound strongly on Monday (the 23rd) after months of steep declines, jumping 19% in a single day to close at $707.70. Although Micron had fallen more than 50% cumulatively since the end of June and retreated about 32% over the past month, the renewed buying of tech stocks, along with corporate earnings, a share‑repurchase program and valuation advantages, give the stock further upside potential.

According to Barron's, Micron dropped 14% on Friday (the 20th), continuing its recent weak trend. However, with Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang returning to his role, investors who entered after last week’s tech sell‑off helped lift the memory‑chip sector on Monday.

Micron’s South Korean rival SK Hynix (000660KS) rose 20%, memory‑card supplier SanDisk (SNDK-US) climbed about 11%, and hard‑drive makers Seagate Technology (STX-US) and Western Digital (WDC-US) each gained roughly 14%.

After Micron’s sharp rebound, investors are now focused on whether the rally can be sustained. Market analysts point to three factors that could act as catalysts for further price gains in the coming weeks.

First, the upcoming corporate earnings releases. Chip and networking equipment maker Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) is scheduled to report on November 26. Like Micron, Marvell benefits from the data‑center build‑out boom, and a strong report would help allay concerns about slowing AI demand growth.

The second catalyst is the share‑repurchase plan. Micron is currently subject to restrictions under the 2024 CHIPS Act, but those constraints will lift on December 9, allowing the company to begin buying back its own shares.

A further positive effect of recent selling pressure is that Micron’s valuation has become extremely cheap. According to FactSet’s compilation of analyst estimates, as of Friday’s close Micron’s stock was trading at just 3.4 times its projected earnings for fiscal year 2027.
By contrast, that multiple had peaked at over 11 times early in 2026.
If earnings beat expectations, the buyback program kicks off, and the valuation remains attractive, investors may re‑accumulate Micron, making Monday’s strong rebound more than just a one‑day blip.

items.title: 黃仁勳復職首場員工大會十大重點：認錯道歉、否認特權、不信接班計畫
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s First All‑Hands After Returning: Ten Key Takeaways – Admission and Apology, Denial of Privilege, Skepticism of Succession Plans
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 週二 (24 日) 在復職後首場全體員工大會上，承認自己違反公司行為準則，為個人行為傷害家人與員工道歉，並透露每天接受一個半小時心理治療。他也承諾調整管理方式，接受可能每月進行一次的 360 度績效評估，讓共事者提供回饋。
不過，黃仁勳同時強調，公司不容忍違反行為準則，並不代表任何違規都會立即遭到解僱。他也否認自己因科技圈特權或政府高層支持而復職，稱董事會已履行應有職責。
根據多家媒體引述知情人士報導，這場會議在輝達加州聖塔克拉拉總部舉行，距離董事會宣布黃仁勳回任執行長僅一天。以下整理此次談話與相關背景的十大重點。
重點一：承認犯下嚴重錯誤，向家人與員工道歉
黃仁勳表示，自己犯下「非常嚴重的個人錯誤」，這也是他先前提出辭呈的原因。
「這將是我主持過最艱難的公司會議，也是我人生中第二艱難的會議。」他說：「最艱難的那場，是與我妻子的會面。」
他承認自己的行為傷害了家人與妻子，感謝公司願意給他第二次機會，也表示將努力爭取「家人給我的第二次機會」。
重點二：每天接受90分鐘心理治療
黃仁勳透露，自己正在透過心理治療改善個人狀況。
「我每天接受一個半小時的心理治療，這對我幫助很大。」
這是他在會中說明如何面對個人問題、尋求改變的具體做法之一。
重點三：否認享有科技圈特權，強調未凌駕法律與規範
黃仁勳反駁外界認為，他因為是科技圈權勢人物而獲得特殊待遇。
「網路上有傳言說，我是『科技兄弟』(tech bro)，所以才能回來。好像因為我是科技兄弟，又穿著一件很高級的外套，就能凌駕法律與行為準則之上。這不是真的。」
他強調，違反規範的行為不會被容忍，公司也並非沒有處理他的行為。
重點四：不容忍違規，不代表一律立即開除
黃仁勳表示，輝達行為準則有很大一部分是由他親自撰寫，目的在於規範員工彼此相處的方式，建立安全的工作環境。
不過，他也解釋，「不容忍」並不等同於所有違規者都必須立刻離職。
「如果你們之中有人違反行為準則，那是不對的、不恰當的，也不會被容忍。但『不會被容忍』，並不代表你一違反行為準則，我們就立刻請你走人。」
他表示，管理團隊仍須評估事實、具體情境及其他因素，再依公司與員工的最佳利益作出決定。
重點五：承認管理有時過火，會傷害與貶低員工
黃仁勳週一重返總部時，也受到大批員工歡迎，有人高喊：「我們愛你，黃仁勳！」
不過，並非所有員工都支持這項決定，仍有人對他的行為及董事會讓他復職感到擔憂。
黃仁勳於員工大會中反省以高強度要求的管理風格，承認這種方式有時會對員工造成傷害。
「我帶來的強度，可以提升其他所有人的表現。但我有時會做得太過火。當我做得太過火，就會傷害別人、貶低他們，削弱他們的自主性。這是不對的。」
他表示，自己需要找出方法，在維持高度投入與工作強度的同時，避免傷害身邊的人。
重點六：接受360度評估，讓主管向董事會回報
「此時此刻，我必須用更高的標準要求自己。」黃仁勳在會中表示。
據報，他將接受 360 度績效評估，向與他共事的人蒐集回饋，頻率可能高達每月一次。
360度回饋(360D Feedback)又稱為「360度績效回饋」、「360度全方位評估」，最早由美商英代爾(Intel)提出。這是一種科學化的人才評鑑工具，透過受評者自身及多方利害關係人進行多向度評估。
黃仁勳表示，自己將是輝達第一位、也是唯一接受這項評估的人，無意將制度推行至全公司。
《華爾街日報》另指出，他告訴員工，公司已啟動一項程序，讓直接向他報告的主管，將對其行為的評價提交董事會。
重點七：向女性員工喊話，承諾維護安全工作環境
黃仁勳表示，公司必須持續維護讓女性安心工作的環境。
他自稱一直是推動女性友善職場的重要支持者，並以公司的彈性工作政策為例，稱這讓員工能兼顧家庭與職涯。
「如果我做了任何危及這個環境的事，我無法形容自己有多難過，我會盡一切所能補救。」
重點八：質疑接班計畫，強調公司沒有他也能運作
黃仁勳表示，自己短暫離開期間，已證明輝達具備自主運作的能力。
「我向你們保證，不論我在不在，這家公司都已建立好機制，能夠執行、執行、再執行，並持續交出財務成果。」
對於接班問題，他直言：「我不相信接班規劃。我認為它有缺陷。不是接班規劃這個概念有問題，而是人們對接班規劃的理解有問題。」
他強調，公司沒有接班規劃，並非不知道這個概念，並自稱是「史上任職最久的科技業執行長」。
重點九：否認政府促成復職，同時感謝提供情報
黃仁勳否認，自己的復職是因為美國政府最高層希望他回來。
「這也完全不是真的。我們的董事會履行了他們應盡的職責。」
不過，據《華爾街日報》報導，他也在會中感謝川普政府讓輝達迅速取得情報，稱這些資訊協助董事會判斷，讓他回任所涉及的國家安全風險偏低。
重點十：說明與川普關係，要求員工把政治留在公司之外
黃仁勳表示，川普確實非常喜歡輝達，也經常誇耀公司表現，但這不代表公司具有黨派立場。
「川普是美國總統，他是我的總統。我會盡一切所能，協助這位總統充分了解情況，讓他作出最符合國家利益的決定。」
他補充，無論下一任總統是誰，自己都會採取相同態度。
「不要以為政治在這家公司扮演任何角色，一點也沒有。我們是最不涉政治的公司。我不喜歡我們在這裡談政治，把它留到家裡。我喜歡我們在這裡談工作。」
離職11天後回歸，相關調查仍未落幕
黃仁勳回任也未讓相關調查告終。董事會仍在追查他是否曾成為外國情報活動的目標，美國國會議員預期他下週出席作證。此外，涉及輝達如何揭露黃仁勳個人行為，以及公司是否遵守美國晶片出口管制的訴訟與其他調查，也仍在進行。
輝達前一交易日因黃仁勳回任執行長而大漲逾 31%，週二則回吐部分漲幅，收低超5% 至每股 155.38 美元。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang on Tuesday (the 24th) held his first all‑employees meeting since returning, admitted that he violated the company’s code of conduct, apologized to his family and staff for his personal misconduct, and disclosed that he receives an hour‑and‑a‑half of psychotherapy each day. He also pledged to adjust his management style and to undergo a possible monthly 360‑degree performance review that will gather feedback from his colleagues.

Huang also stressed that while the company does not tolerate code‑of‑conduct breaches, not every violation will result in immediate termination. He denied that his reinstatement was due to any tech‑industry privilege or government backing, saying the board has fulfilled its duties.

According to multiple media outlets citing insiders, the meeting was held at NVIDIA’s headquarters in Santa Clara, California, just one day after the board announced Huang’s return as CEO. Below are the ten key points from his remarks and related background.
Key point one: Admission of a serious mistake and apology to family and employees.
Huang said he had made a “very serious personal mistake,” which was the reason he previously tendered his resignation.
“This is the toughest company meeting I’ve ever led, and the second‑toughest meeting of my life,” he said. “The toughest one was the meeting with my wife.”
He acknowledged that his actions hurt his family and wife, thanked the company for giving him a second chance, and said he will work to earn the “second chance” his family has given him.
Key point two: Daily 90‑minute psychotherapy.
Huang revealed that he is using psychotherapy to improve his personal situation.
“I have an hour and a half of therapy every day, and it helps me a lot,” he said.
He presented this as one concrete way he is confronting his personal issues and seeking change.
Key point three: Denial of any tech‑industry privilege and emphasis that he is not above law or policy.
Huang rebutted claims that he received special treatment because he is a tech‑industry power figure.

“There are rumors online that I’m a ‘tech bro,’ which is why I could come back. It’s as if being a tech bro and wearing a fancy coat lets me rise above the law and the code of conduct. That’s not true,” he said.
He stressed that violations of policy will not be tolerated and that the company has indeed addressed his misconduct.
Key point four: Zero tolerance does not equal automatic dismissal.
Huang explained that a large portion of NVIDIA’s code of conduct was written by him personally to set standards for how employees interact and to create a safe workplace.
However, he clarified that “zero tolerance” does not mean every violator is immediately fired.
“If any of you violate the code, it’s wrong, it’s inappropriate, and it won’t be tolerated. But ‘won’t be tolerated’ does not mean we will kick you out the moment you breach the code,” he said.
He added that the management team must assess facts, context, and other factors before deciding what is in the best interest of the company and its employees.
Key point five: Admission that his management style can be overbearing and diminish employees.
When Huang returned to headquarters on Monday, he was greeted by a large crowd of staff chanting, “We love you, Jensen!”
Nevertheless, not all employees supported the decision; some remain concerned about his behavior and the board’s choice to reinstate him.
During the all‑hands, Huang reflected on his high‑intensity management style and admitted that it can sometimes harm staff.
“The intensity I bring can lift everyone’s performance, but I sometimes go too far. When I go too far, I hurt people, demean them, and undermine their autonomy. That’s wrong,” he said.
He said he needs to find ways to maintain high engagement and workload without hurting those around him.
Key point six: Adoption of 360‑degree reviews with supervisors reporting to the board.
“Right now, I have to hold myself to an even higher standard,” Huang said during the meeting.
According to reports, he will undergo a 360‑degree performance review, collecting feedback from those he works with, potentially as often as once a month.

The 360‑degree feedback system, also known as “360‑degree performance feedback” or “360‑degree comprehensive assessment,” was originally introduced by Intel. It is a scientific talent‑evaluation tool that gathers multi‑source input from the reviewee and various stakeholders.
Huang said he will be the first—and only—person at NVIDIA to undergo this assessment and has no intention of rolling it out company‑wide.
The Wall Street Journal also noted that he told employees the company has launched a process whereby his direct reports will submit evaluations of his behavior to the board.
Key point seven: Message to female employees and pledge to keep the workplace safe.
Huang said the company must continuously maintain an environment where women feel safe and comfortable working.
He described himself as a longtime champion of a women‑friendly workplace and cited NVIDIA’s flexible‑work policies as an example that helps staff balance family and career.
“If I do anything that jeopardizes that environment, I can’t describe how upset I would be, and I will do everything I can to make it right,” he said.
Key point eight: Questioning the succession plan and stressing that the company can operate without him.
Huang said his brief absence proved that NVIDIA can run autonomously.
“I assure you, whether I’m here or not, the company has built mechanisms that can execute, execute, and execute again, continuously delivering financial results,” he said.
Regarding succession, he bluntly stated, “I don’t believe in the succession plan. I think it’s flawed. It’s not the concept of a succession plan that’s the problem, but people’s understanding of it.”
He emphasized that the lack of a succession plan does not mean the company is unaware of the concept, and he called himself “the longest‑serving CEO in tech history.”
Key point nine: Denial of government involvement in his return while thanking them for intelligence.
Huang denied that his reinstatement was driven by the highest levels of the U.S. government.
“That’s completely false. Our board fulfilled its responsibilities,” he said.

However, the Wall Street Journal reported that he also thanked the Trump administration for quickly providing intelligence that helped the board assess that the national‑security risks of his return were low.
Key point ten: Explanation of his relationship with Trump and urging staff to keep politics out of the company.
Huang said Trump is indeed a big fan of NVIDIA and often boasts about the company’s performance, but that does not make NVIDIA a partisan organization.

“Trump is the President of the United States; he’s my president. I will do everything I can to help him fully understand the situation so he can make the decision that best serves the nation’s interests,” he said.
He added that regardless of who the next president is, he will take the same approach.
“Don’t think politics plays any role in this company—not at all. We are the least political company. I don’t like us talking politics here; keep it at home. I like us talking work here,” he said.
Eleven days after his resignation, the related investigations remain unresolved.

Huang’s return has not ended the ongoing probes. The board is still investigating whether he was ever targeted by foreign intelligence operations, and U.S. lawmakers expect him to testify next week. Lawsuits and other investigations into how NVIDIA disclosed Huang’s personal conduct and whether the company complied with U.S. chip‑export controls are also ongoing.
NVIDIA’s stock jumped more than 31% on the trading day before Huang’s reinstatement, but on Tuesday it gave back part of those gains, closing down over 5% at $155.38 per share.

items.title: 亞馬遜挑戰Starlink先靠SpaceX！自家火箭接連失利、衛星卡在地面
items.title_en: Amazon Turns to SpaceX to Challenge Starlink After Its Own Rockets Falter
paras: 亞馬遜(Amazon) (AMZN-US)為追趕SpaceX旗下Starlink的低軌衛星網路，卻在自家火箭接連出包後，不得不提前動用競爭對手馬斯克旗下SpaceX的運載火箭。亞馬遜低軌衛星計畫Amazon Leo周二(24日)透過歐洲Ariane 6火箭成功發射36顆衛星，使在軌衛星總數增加至432顆。
亞馬遜官員向《Ars Technica》證實，由於主要發射合作夥伴聯合發射聯盟(ULA)的火神(Centaur)火箭發生任務異常並停飛，公司決定提前使用先前向SpaceX採購的Falcon 9火箭。原定明年執行的下一次發射已提前至12月，後續也將安排多場密集發射任務。
Amazon Leo前身為柯伊伯計畫(Project Kuiper)，是亞馬遜布局低軌衛星網路的重要計畫，目標直接挑戰SpaceX的Starlink。目前Starlink在軌衛星已超過1.1萬顆，規模遠遠領先Amazon Leo。
美國監管機構今年已批准Amazon Leo第二代衛星星座計畫，亞馬遜預計在2030年代將衛星數量擴大至7,000顆以上，並規劃推出衛星直連手機服務，進一步拓展網路覆蓋範圍。
為了完成第一代星座部署，亞馬遜約五年前一口氣預訂西方所有中大型火箭共108次發射，目標將3,232顆第一代衛星送入低軌道。不過，當時簽約的ULA火神、歐洲Ariane 6，以及藍色起源(Blue Origin)的New Glenn火箭，大多仍處於開發階段。
截至目前，這批火箭合計僅完成17次發射，其中1次失敗，發射進度遠低於亞馬遜原先的部署需求。近期接連發生的火箭事故，更讓亞馬遜不得不重新調整發射安排。
New Glenn今年5月曾在藍色起源位於佛羅里達州的發射設施發生爆炸，至今仍停飛；ULA火神則在11月15日執行亞馬遜衛星發射任務時，升空約10分鐘後發生異常，導致搭載的40顆衛星未能進入預定軌道，全部損失。
《科技新報》報導，火神火箭今年2月執行美國太空軍任務時，曾發生固體火箭助推器噴嘴異常，太空軍隨後暫停其國家安全發射任務。ULA修改噴嘴設計與製程後，火神才恢復飛行。
然而，11月15日的失敗任務仍是亞馬遜與ULA簽訂38次火神發射訂單中的首場任務。Amazon Leo發射系統總監Melissa Wuerl先前表示，火神原本預計負責發射近1,500顆衛星，約占整個第一代星座規模的一半。
面對火箭供應不穩，亞馬遜早在2023年便開始向SpaceX採購發射服務。Falcon 9去年已完成前三次Amazon Leo發射任務，每次各搭載24顆衛星，亞馬遜之後又追加10次發射訂單。
《Ars Technica》指出，短期內SpaceX將是亞馬遜最有把握的衛星運載工具。這也形成耐人尋味的局面：亞馬遜正積極挑戰馬斯克的Starlink，卻必須依賴對手的火箭，才能加快自家衛星網路的部署。
SpaceX則正逐步將Starlink衛星發射任務轉交給運載能力更大的Starship火箭，藉此釋出Falcon 9產能。不過，據報SpaceX已停止接受2028年之後的Falcon 9商業發射訂單，亞馬遜未來能否持續取得足夠發射檔期，仍存在不確定性。
歐洲方面，Arianespace今年已成功使用Ariane 6為亞馬遜執行4次發射任務，亞馬遜並於9月追加6次發射訂單。但Ariane 6目前每年最多只能執行約9至10次發射，今年實際飛行約6次，預計12月底前還會再執行1次。
由於發射需求持續增加，歐洲各國部長正考慮擴大Ariane 6產能，但最快要到下個月才會作出決定，短期內難以立即解決亞馬遜的發射需求。
至於ULA，亞馬遜已支付數億美元協助擴建其位於卡納維爾角的發射設施，目標是讓火神火箭每年執行25次發射。不過，ULA過去三年火神火箭僅執行5次任務，且已有1次失敗，實際發射能力與亞馬遜的部署需求仍有明顯落差。
New Glenn則預計最快明年初才有機會恢復飛行，但其發射檔期又以美國國家航空暨太空總署(NASA)的登月任務為優先，亞馬遜能否取得足夠的發射資源仍不明朗。
儘管火神火箭任務失利，亞馬遜仍發表聲明稱ULA是「值得信賴的合作夥伴」。然而，亞馬遜目前仍有數百顆衛星在倉庫等待發射，若要追趕Starlink超過1.1萬顆的龐大在軌規模，除了加快衛星製造，更需要穩定且充足的火箭運載能力。
這場競賽最具諷刺意味之處在於，亞馬遜要挑戰的正是馬斯克的Starlink，但眼下最可靠、能協助其衛星順利升空的運載火箭，卻掌握在競爭對手SpaceX手中。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) is racing to catch up with SpaceX’s Starlink low‑Earth‑orbit satellite network, but after a string of failures with its own launch vehicles it has been forced to turn to rival SpaceX’s rockets. On Tuesday (the 24th), Amazon’s low‑orbit satellite program, Amazon Leo, successfully launched 36 satellites on a European Ariane 6 rocket, bringing its total on‑orbit satellites to 432.

Amazon officials told Ars Technica that because the company’s primary launch partner United Launch Alliance (ULA) had a Centaur rocket suffer a mission anomaly and be grounded, they decided to move up the use of Falcon 9 rockets that had already been purchased from SpaceX. The next launch, originally scheduled for next year, has been brought forward to December, with a series of intensive launch campaigns planned thereafter.

Amazon Leo, formerly known as Project Kuiper, is Amazon’s flagship low‑Earth‑orbit satellite initiative aimed directly at challenging SpaceX’s Starlink. Starlink already has more than 11,000 satellites in orbit, far outpacing Amazon Leo’s current constellation.

U.S. regulators approved the second‑generation Amazon Leo satellite constellation this year. Amazon plans to expand the fleet to over 7,000 satellites in the 2030s and is also developing satellite‑direct‑to‑phone services to broaden coverage.

To deploy the first‑generation constellation, Amazon placed orders about five years ago for a total of 108 launches on all major Western medium‑to‑large rockets, intending to put 3,232 first‑generation satellites into low Earth orbit. At the time, the contracts were with ULA’s Centaur, Europe’s Ariane 6, and Blue Origin’s New Glenn rockets, most of which were still under development.

To date, those rockets have completed only 17 launches combined, with one failure, far short of Amazon’s original deployment schedule. A spate of recent rocket incidents has forced Amazon to reshuffle its launch plans.

New Glenn suffered an explosion in May at Blue Origin’s Florida launch site and remains grounded; ULA’s Centaur experienced an anomaly about 10 minutes after liftoff on a Amazon satellite mission on Nov. 15, causing all 40 payload satellites to miss orbit and be lost.

According to TechNews, the Centaur’s solid‑rocket booster nozzle malfunctioned during a U.S. Space Force mission in February, prompting the Space Force to suspend its national‑security launches. After ULA redesigned the nozzle and revised its manufacturing process, the Centaur returned to flight.

Nevertheless, the Nov. 15 failure was the first of the 38 Centaur launch orders Amazon signed with ULA. Amazon Leo launch‑system director Melissa Wuerl had previously said the Centaur was slated to launch roughly 1,500 satellites, about half of the first‑generation constellation’s total size.

Facing an unstable rocket supply, Amazon began procuring launch services from SpaceX as early as 2023. Falcon 9 completed the first three Amazon Leo launches last year, each carrying 24 satellites, and Amazon has since placed an additional ten launch orders.

Ars Technica notes that in the short term SpaceX will be Amazon’s most reliable satellite launch provider. This creates an ironic situation: Amazon is aggressively challenging Elon Musk’s Starlink while having to rely on its competitor’s rockets to accelerate its own network deployment.

SpaceX is gradually shifting Starlink launches to its larger‑capacity Starship vehicle to free up Falcon 9 capacity. However, reports say SpaceX has stopped taking commercial Falcon 9 launch orders beyond 2028, leaving uncertainty over whether Amazon will continue to secure sufficient launch slots in the future.

In Europe, Arianespace has successfully used Ariane 6 to conduct four Amazon launches this year and Amazon added six more launch orders in September. Ariane 6 can currently perform only about nine to ten launches per year; it flew roughly six times this year and is expected to fly once more before the end of December.

Because launch demand keeps rising, European ministers are considering expanding Ariane 6 production capacity, but a decision won’t be made until next month, so the short‑term launch shortfall for Amazon remains unresolved.

Regarding ULA, Amazon has paid hundreds of millions of dollars to help expand its launch complex at Cape Canaveral, aiming to enable the Centaur to conduct 25 launches per year. Yet in the past three years the Centaur flew only five missions, with one failure, falling far short of Amazon’s deployment needs.

New Glenn is not expected to resume flights until early next year at the earliest, and its launch slots are being prioritized for NASA’s lunar missions, making it unclear whether Amazon can secure enough launch resources.

Despite the Centaur setback, Amazon issued a statement calling ULA a “trusted partner.” Amazon still has several hundred satellites in storage awaiting launch, and to catch up with Starlink’s more than 11,000 satellites in orbit it will need not only faster satellite production but also stable and ample launch capacity.

The most ironic aspect of this race is that Amazon is trying to challenge Musk’s Starlink, yet the most reliable rockets capable of getting its satellites into space are now in the hands of its competitor, SpaceX.

items.title: 美光暴跌超10% 遭投行降評、腰斬目標價 示警記憶體「供過於求」風險升高
items.title_en: Micron Plummets Over 10% After Investment Bank Downgrades and Halves Target Price, Warning of Rising Oversupply Risk in Memory Market
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，美光 (MU-US) 週二 (24 日) 收盤重挫 10.97%，報每股 630.07 美元，較 6 月 25 日的歷史收盤高點 1,213.56 美元回落約 48.08%。法國巴黎銀行 (BNP Paribas) 分析師警告，記憶體需求可能比市場預期更早觸頂，資料中心建置延誤與客戶縮減記憶體用量，恐使目前供不應求的市場轉向供給過剩，進而削弱美光的定價能力。
法巴分析師 Karl Ackerman 將美光評等由「優於大盤」下調至「中立」，目標價由 1,700 美元大幅降至 775 美元，降幅約 54%。美光週二暴跌超 10%，反映市場對記憶體價格高檔能否延續，以及產業景氣波動的疑慮。
資料中心若延後落成 供需缺口恐加速收斂
Ackerman 指出，記憶體市場出現「供過於求情境的風險正在升高」，需求可能比預期更早觸頂，隨後進入供給過剩階段。
他關注的關鍵風險之一，是資料中心許可核發延誤。記憶體與儲存產業高度依賴資料中心投資，伺服器占動態隨機存取記憶體 (DRAM) 與 NAND 快閃記憶體需求的比重均至少達一半。一旦資料中心專案進度受阻，相關資本支出也可能遞延，拖慢記憶體需求成長，讓供給有時間追上需求。
Ackerman 認為，目前需求明顯超過供給，是支撐記憶體價格維持高檔的「主要因素」。因此，若資料中心建置放緩，即使需求未立即衰退，也可能因供需缺口縮小而削弱價格支撐。
高價促使客戶縮減用量 消費市場難靠長約鎖價
除了資料中心進度，記憶體價格上漲本身，也正促使客戶調整產品配置。
Ackerman 指出，輝達 (NVDA-US) 已降低新一代 Vera Rubin Ultra 架構的高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 配置量，其他供應商也減少個人電腦與行動裝置搭載的記憶體容量。這類調整可能壓抑需求，成為美光業務的另一項阻力。
他進一步表示，手機與個人電腦市場較少採用同時約定長期採購量與價格的協議，使記憶體製造商更難透過長約，鎖定消費性應用市場的有利售價。
晨星：2027 年訂單大致底定 市場提前反映後續支出風險
晨星 (Morningstar) 分析師 William Kerwin 則向《MarketWatch》表示，市場已開始反映未來 AI 支出下滑機率升高的風險，而這種情況可能在兩年後出現。
不過，他也強調，2027 年 AI 基礎建設供應鏈的訂單與供給安排「幾乎已經底定」，顯示近期需求仍有既有訂單支撐，市場疑慮主要指向更長期的投資走勢。
Kerwin 另指出，黃仁勳相關事件與輝達內部動盪，也為美光等主要 AI 基礎建設供應商增添不確定性。
「如果輝達的成長故事出現長期裂痕，最終可能意味著 AI 支出減少，進而打擊美光的需求。」他說。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Micron (MU-US) closed Tuesday (the 24th) with a steep drop of 10.97%, at $630.07 per share, down about 48.08% from its historical high of $1,213.56 on June 25. BNP Paribas analysts warned that memory demand may peak earlier than the market expects, with data‑center build‑out delays and customers cutting memory usage potentially turning the currently tight market into an oversupplied one, thereby weakening Micron’s pricing power.

BNP Paribas analyst Karl Ackerman lowered Micron’s rating from "outperform" to "neutral" and cut the target price sharply from $1,700 to $775, a reduction of roughly 54%. Micron’s tumble of more than 10% on Tuesday reflected market doubts about whether high memory prices can be sustained and about industry cyclical volatility.
If data‑center roll‑outs are delayed, the supply‑demand gap could close faster.
Ackerman noted that the risk of an "oversupply scenario" in the memory market is rising, with demand potentially peaking earlier than expected and then moving into a surplus phase.

One key risk he highlighted is delays in data‑center permit approvals. The memory and storage sectors are heavily dependent on data‑center investment, with servers accounting for at least half of DRAM and NAND flash demand. If data‑center projects stall, related capex may be deferred, slowing memory demand growth and giving supply time to catch up.

Ackerman believes that current demand clearly exceeds supply, which is the main factor keeping memory prices high. Therefore, even if demand does not immediately decline, a slowdown in data‑center construction could shrink the supply‑demand gap and erode price support.
High prices are prompting customers to cut usage, and consumer markets cannot rely on long‑term price‑locking contracts
Beyond data‑center timing, the rise in memory prices itself is causing customers to adjust product configurations.

Ackerman pointed out that Nvidia (NVDA-US) has reduced the amount of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) in its new Vera Rubin Ultra architecture, and other vendors are also scaling back memory capacity in PCs and mobile devices. Such adjustments could suppress demand and become another headwind for Micron’s business.

He added that the smartphone and PC markets rarely use long‑term purchase‑quantity and price agreements, making it harder for memory makers to lock in favorable prices for consumer applications through long contracts.
Morningstar: 2027 Orders Basically Set, Market Already Pricing In Future Spending Risks
Morningstar analyst William Kerwin told MarketWatch that the market has begun to price in a higher risk of AI spending slowdown in the future, a scenario that could materialize in about two years.

However, he emphasized that AI infrastructure supply‑chain orders and supply plans for 2027 are "almost set," indicating that near‑term demand still has a base of existing orders, and market concerns are mainly about longer‑term investment trends.
Kerwin also noted that events involving Jensen Huang and internal turmoil at Nvidia add uncertainty for major AI infrastructure suppliers such as Micron.
"If Nvidia’s growth story develops a long‑term crack, it could ultimately mean reduced AI spending, which would hit Micron’s demand," he said.

items.title: 美股先爆衝又急跌令投資人陷進退兩難　趨勢反轉訊號何時出現？
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Surge Then Plummet, Leaving Investors Stuck Between a Rock and a Hard Place – When Will a Trend‑Reversal Signal Appear?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)董事會周一(23日)宣布黃仁勳即日起回任執行長，市場情緒在數日內急轉，標普500當日大漲4.73%至7237.17點，創2025年4月以來最大單日漲幅，那斯達克飆升6.51%，輝達本身暴漲31.48%，單日市值回補逾9500億美元，並帶動亞太股市24日開盤集體跟漲。
這波反彈表面是「人事利多」，底層卻由多重交易機制疊加引爆。野村證券跨資產策略師Charlie McElligott指出，VIX恐慌指數單日重挫逾9點，使深度價外賣權快速流失價值，交易商被迫回補先前空頭避險部位；空頭停損、散戶追價接踵而來。更關鍵的是被動買盤：槓桿ETF為維持每日目標倍數，尾盤再平衡預估買入約410億美元，單日規模創野村史上第二大紀錄，僅次於今年4月的465億。
量化趨勢資金也出現轉向訊號。標普收盤站上7043點後，野村12個月CTA模型由空翻多，預計帶來約161億美元指數期貨回補與25億美元那斯達克買盤，同期波動率控制基金雖賣出110至160億美元，仍被槓桿ETF買盤壓過。
但華爾街對「反轉成立」態度謹慎。McElligott提醒，金融條件緊縮、實質利率走高、信用利差擴大與AI資本支出預期重估等結構壓力並未消失。
高盛歐洲股票策略師Sharon Bell表示，輝達管理層變動只是消除不確定性，AI行情核心在於企業能否從巨額資本開支賺回利潤，「市場還沒看到項目級的回報證明」。
她並建議，投資人應以股票搭配債券、降低集中風險，並留意與AI關聯度較低的歐股作為分散配置。
摩根士丹利策略師Michael Wilson則把周一漲勢視為拋售後的「反射性反彈」，不認為已確認底部；BTIG技術分析師Jonathan Krinsky也指出，指數低於200日均線時單日漲超4%，後續五日平均仍會回跌2.1%。
對一般投資人而言，擇時難度正急劇上升。那斯達克100指數上周五(20日)跌5.6%、周一漲6.7%，錯過單日大漲將嚴重侵蝕長期報酬。
根據富蘭克林鄧普頓估算，1999年底投入1萬美元並長抱，至今資產將超過7.5萬美元；若在崩跌中離場、錯過最大漲幅，僅剩約3.3萬。
目前，機構共識是不必清空持股，但應避免追高槓桿、控好波動，把「AI能不能變現」作為未來數季真正定價變數。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) board announced on Monday (the 23rd) that Jensen Huang will resume his role as CEO effective immediately, triggering a rapid swing in market sentiment. The S&P 500 jumped 4.73% to 7,237.17 points that day – the biggest single‑day gain since April 2025 – while the Nasdaq surged 6.51%. Nvidia itself rocketed 31.48%, restoring more than $950 billion of market value in a single session and pulling Asian‑Pacific markets higher at the open on the 24th.

The rally may look like a simple “management‑related boost,” but it was actually ignited by multiple trading mechanisms stacking together. Nomura’s cross‑asset strategist Charlie McElligott noted that the VIX panic index fell more than 9 points in one day, eroding the value of deep out‑of‑the‑money puts and forcing dealers to cover their short hedges; short sellers then hit stop‑losses and retail investors chased the price. Even more critical was passive buying: leveraged ETFs, to maintain their daily target multiples, were estimated to buy about $41 billion in the closing‑hour rebalancing, the second‑largest one‑day volume in Nomura’s history, behind only the $46.5 billion in April this year.

Quantitative trend funds also showed a turning signal. After the S&P closed above 7,043 points, Nomura’s 12‑month CTA model flipped from short to long, forecasting roughly $16.1 billion of index‑future buying and $2.5 billion of Nasdaq buying. At the same time, volatility‑control funds sold between $11 billion and $16 billion, but their sales were outweighed by leveraged‑ETF purchases.

Wall Street remains cautious about declaring a “reversal” complete. McElligott warned that structural pressures – tighter financial conditions, higher real rates, widening credit spreads and a reassessment of AI‑related capital‑expenditure expectations – have not disappeared.

Goldman Sachs Europe equity strategist Sharon Bell said the Nvidia leadership change merely removes uncertainty; the AI rally’s core hinges on whether companies can recoup the massive cap‑ex with profits, and “the market has not yet seen project‑level proof of returns.”
She advised investors to pair equities with bonds, reduce concentration risk, and consider European stocks with lower AI exposure for diversification.

Morgan Stanley strategist Michael Wilson described Monday’s rally as a “reflective bounce” after a sell‑off, not a confirmed bottom. BTIG technical analyst Jonathan Krinsky also pointed out that when an index climbs more than 4% in a day while staying below its 200‑day moving average, the five‑day average typically falls back about 2.1%.

For the average investor, timing is becoming dramatically harder. The Nasdaq‑100 fell 5.6% on Friday (the 20th) and jumped 6.7% on Monday; missing the single‑day surge would severely erode long‑term returns.

Franklin Templeton estimates that a $10,000 investment made at the end of 1999 and held ever since would now be worth over $75,000; exiting during the crash and missing the biggest rally would leave only about $33,000.

Currently, the institutional consensus is not to liquidate positions, but to avoid chasing leveraged highs, manage volatility, and treat “whether AI can be monetized” as the key pricing variable for the coming quarters.

items.title: 台灣會被加稅嗎？彭博：美國新關稅最快周二公布
items.title_en: Will Taiwan be taxed? Bloomberg: New US tariffs could be announced as early as Tuesday
paras: 據《彭博》周二(24日)引述知情人士報導，美國最快將於周二宣布調高中國、歐盟及其他十多個經濟體商品的關稅。台灣也在美方今年3月啟動的301調查名單內，但是否納入此次加稅措施，仍待正式公布。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)稍早報導，相關消息最快本周公布，《彭博》則進一步將可能宣布的時點縮小至周二。不過，新關稅的稅率、涵蓋商品與生效日期仍未明朗，川普也經常調整貿易政策，公布時程仍可能變動。
根據美國貿易代表署(USTR)3月11日公告，該署依據《1974年貿易法》301條款，對包括台灣、中國、歐盟、日本、南韓、印度及越南等16個經濟體啟動調查，檢視製造業結構性產能過剩及相關政策，是否構成不合理或歧視性措施，並對美國商業造成負擔或限制。
這份公告確認台灣屬於原始調查對象，但《彭博》此次報導並未明確指出，台灣是否將被加徵關稅。對台適用範圍、稅率及可能排除的產品，仍須等待美方正式措施。
美國貿易代表葛里爾(Jamieson Greer)先前指控，相關經濟體透過補貼及其他政府扶持措施，推升工業產能，使企業得以大量出口低價商品，衝擊美國生產商。他上周接受《彭博電視》訪問時表示，產能過剩調查預計「很快」完成。
這項調查於今年3月、最高法院推翻川普先前全球關稅後啟動，是川普政府尋找替代關稅措施的一環。301條款允許美方針對影響美國商業的不公平貿易行為，採取加徵關稅等回應措施。
此外，《華爾街日報》稍早報導，新一輪關稅可能與今年7月公布的另一項關稅疊加。美方當時以相關經濟體未充分打擊強迫勞動為由，對約60個經濟體設定10%至12.5%的關稅，該措施目前仍面臨美國國際貿易法院的司法挑戰。
白宮未立即回應《彭博》的置評請求，USTR則拒絕評論。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg on Tuesday (the 24th), citing sources, the United States could announce on Tuesday the imposition of higher tariffs on goods from China, the EU and more than ten other economies. Taiwan is also on the list of entities under the U.S. Section 301 investigation launched in March, but whether it will be included in this round of tariff hikes remains to be formally announced.

The Wall Street Journal reported earlier that the news could be released as early as this week, and Bloomberg narrowed the possible announcement window to Tuesday. However, the tariff rates, covered products and effective date are still unclear, and President Trump frequently adjusts trade policy, so the timetable could still change.

According to a March 11 announcement by the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR), the agency launched investigations under Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act into 16 economies—including Taiwan, China, the EU, Japan, South Korea, India and Vietnam—to examine structural overcapacity in manufacturing and related policies for signs of unreasonable or discriminatory measures that burden or restrict U.S. businesses.

The announcement confirmed that Taiwan is among the original subjects of the investigation, but Bloomberg’s report did not specify whether Taiwan will face additional tariffs. The scope, rates and possible product exclusions for Taiwan will have to await formal U.S. action.

USTR official Jamieson Greer previously accused the targeted economies of using subsidies and other government support to boost industrial capacity, allowing firms to export low‑priced goods that hurt U.S. producers. He told Bloomberg TV last week that the overcapacity investigation is expected to be completed “very soon.”

The investigation was launched in March after the Supreme Court overturned Trump’s earlier global tariffs and is part of the Trump administration’s search for alternative tariff measures. Section 301 allows the U.S. to respond to unfair trade practices that affect American commerce with actions such as imposing tariffs.

The Wall Street Journal also reported that the new round of tariffs could stack on top of another set announced in July, which imposed 10% to 12.5% duties on about 60 economies for insufficient action against forced labor. That measure is currently facing a legal challenge before the U.S. International Trade Court.
The White House did not immediately respond to Bloomberg’s request for comment, and the USTR declined to comment.

items.title: 民航局推機場智慧永續發展 聚焦國際經驗與AI科技
items.title_en: Civil Aviation Administration Promotes Smart Sustainable Airport Development, Focusing on International Experience and AI Technology
paras: 交通部民航局今(24)日舉辦「2026台灣智慧永續機場發展論壇」，智慧機場及永續航空為此次論壇兩大主軸，並介紹我國智慧機場AI推動方向，民航局局長何淑萍表示，為了因應淨零轉型與數位科技快速發展，智慧化及永續化將是提升機場韌性與國際競爭力的重要關鍵。此次論壇邀請國際機場協會(ACI)、日本中部國際機場、Google、微軟等國際科技公司、行政院AI民間委員及鑫蘊林科等國內外講者及科技業界代表交流國際經驗與創新應用，共有54個單位、約120位產官學代表參與。
交通部次長林國顯強調航空器是國家的延伸，旅客會透過航空器感受一個國家，這些年台灣的航空公司持續引進新飛機，降低了耗能，而民航局也努力改善航管系統，減少飛機盤繞過程造成的油耗，台灣的航空業也開始使用SAF(永續航空燃料)，以達成節能減碳的目標。

何淑萍表示，智慧化與永續化是未來機場發展的重要方向，民航局會承擔更重要的責任，但光靠公部門的努力還不夠，更需所有產業緊密結合，帶動航空業一起往前走，
paras_en: The Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transportation held the "2026 Taiwan Smart Sustainable Airport Development Forum" today (24th). The forum centered on smart airports and sustainable aviation, and introduced Taiwan's AI-driven smart airport initiatives. Director He Shuping said that to meet net‑zero transformation and rapid digital technology development, intelligence and sustainability are key to enhancing airport resilience and international competitiveness. The forum invited speakers and industry representatives from the International Air Transport Association (IATA), Japan’s Chubu International Airport, Google, Microsoft, the Executive Yuan’s AI private sector committee, Xin Yunlin Technology and others, with 54 organizations and about 120 participants from government, industry and academia exchanging international experience and innovative applications.

Deputy Minister Lin Guoxian emphasized that aircraft are an extension of a nation; travelers experience a country through its airlines. In recent years Taiwanese airlines have continuously introduced new aircraft, reducing energy consumption, while the Civil Aviation Administration has worked to improve air traffic management systems to cut fuel burn from holding patterns. Taiwan’s aviation sector is also adopting sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) to achieve energy‑saving and carbon‑reduction goals.

At the meeting, the Civil Aviation Administration reported progress on green airport initiatives and obtaining international certifications, and outlined Taiwan’s AI‑driven smart airport strategy. Wang Yuzhen, Director of Kaohsiung International Airport, shared the airport’s Carbon Accreditation (ACA) experience; Kaohsiung Airport achieved Level 4 certification in 2026, demonstrating continued carbon‑reduction efforts.

Naoyuki Shigeno, Director of the Sustainable Development Office at Japan’s Chubu International Airport, described how the airport collaborates with local governments to collect household waste cooking oil and develop a sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) supply chain. Through cross‑sector collaboration and resource recycling, the initiative brings sustainability into everyday life.

Huang Gonghui, CEO of RECCESSARY, analyzed global SAF pricing, supply‑demand dynamics, and technology trends, noting that supply and cost challenges remain. He recommended that Taiwan pursue a dual track of policy support and technological innovation to achieve large‑scale SAF deployment.

Regarding smart airports, Huang Wuqiang, Head of the Airport Terminal Management Division, presented Taiwan’s AI‑driven smart airport roadmap, highlighting how data integration and collaborative decision‑making can boost operational efficiency and service quality.

Wayne An, Technical Director for Google Cloud Taiwan, shared a test‑flight case where AI was used to predict high‑altitude weather and adjust flight levels, successfully reducing contrail‑induced warming and demonstrating climate‑impact mitigation.

Hua Kailong, Chief Technology Officer for Microsoft Taiwan, described how Microsoft combines AI with digital‑twin technology to instantly analyze flight delays or security‑check bottlenecks, providing real‑time mitigation suggestions for staff decision‑making, making AI a collaborative partner in airport operations.

He Shuping stated that intelligence and sustainability are crucial directions for future airport development. The Civil Aviation Administration will assume greater responsibility, but public‑sector efforts alone are insufficient; close collaboration across all industries is needed to drive the aviation sector forward.

items.title: 押反1慘翻車！00632R爆近4千萬鉅額違約交割 暌違近2年再現ETF案例
items.title_en: Reverse‑ETF 1 Crash! 00632R Hits Nearly NT$40 Million Default Settlement, First ETF Default in Almost Two Years
paras: 台股劇烈震盪再傳慘案！證交所今(24)日公告，國泰證券板橋分公司申報一筆「元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)」違約交割，金額高達 3,946萬9,000元，為暌違近 2 年再現 ETF 違約案例。
依台股「T+2」交割制度回推，該筆違約的實際交易日落在上周五(11月20日)。當日台股遭遇恐慌性賣壓，加權指數終場暴跌 2,393.6 點、跌幅 6.23%，收在 36,033.29 點，寫下台股史上第三大單日收盤跌點；權值股台積電重挫百元收在 2,000 元，聯發科與台達電雙雙跌停，集中市場單日融資餘額更創紀錄大減 491.41 億元。
觀察 00632R 近期走勢，宛如雲霄飛車般劇烈震盪。上周五 00632R 吸引大批避險與短線資金湧入，股價自 12.13 元開出後一路衝高至 12.58 元，終場大漲 7.19%、收在 12.52 元，爆出 57.78 萬張大量。
不料周末救市政策出爐後，台股本周展開報復性反攻，00632R 周一(23日)爆出 71.15 萬張天量反轉收黑在 12.16 元；今(24)日則因黃仁勳回鍋遭賣壓摜殺，重挫 1.21 元、跌幅達 9.95%，終場以 10.95 元跌停作收。對照周五高點，短短兩個交易日波段跌幅近 13%，也讓在高點追價的投資人瞬間套牢，甚至引發違約交割風暴。
回顧近年 ETF 違約案例，上一次達鉅額揭露標準為 2024 年 12 月 17 日的「元大滬深300正2(00637L-TW)」，當時因陸股劇烈震盪，國票證券南港分公司申報違約金額達 3,229.67 萬元；同年 10 月櫃買市場的「永豐中國科技50大(00887-TW)」亦曾因溢價失控暴跌，爆出 1,469.26 萬元違約。
證交所提醒，槓桿及反向型 ETF 具備複利效果與波動放大特性，在極端行情下往往伴隨劇烈的折溢價變化，投資人進行短線當沖或波段操作時，務必審慎評估自身財力與交割資金水位，切勿過度擴張信用，以免面臨違約交割的信用破產與法律責任。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks experienced severe volatility and another disaster struck. The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced today (the 24th) that Cathay Securities’ Banqiao branch reported a default settlement for the Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse‑1 ETF (00632R‑TW) amounting to NT$39,467,900, marking the first ETF default case in nearly two years.

Based on the T+2 settlement system, the actual trade date of the default was last Friday (November 20). On that day, the market faced panic selling, with the weighted index plunging 2,393.6 points, a 6.23% drop, closing at 36,033.29 points—the third‑largest single‑day point decline in Taiwan market history. Heavyweights such as TSMC fell over NT$100 to NT$2,000, while MediaTek and Delta Electronics hit their daily limits down, and the margin balance in the spot market shrank by a record NT$49.141 billion.

Looking at 00632R’s recent price action, it resembled a roller‑coaster. Last Friday, the ETF attracted a flood of hedging and short‑term capital, climbing from an opening price of NT$12.13 to a high of NT$12.58, ending the session up 7.19% at NT$12.52 and generating a massive 577,800 contracts.

However, after rescue policies were announced over the weekend, the market launched a retaliatory rally this week. On Monday (the 23rd) 00632R reversed sharply, trading a huge 711,500 contracts and closing lower at NT$12.16. On Tuesday (the 24th), pressure from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s return triggered selling, dragging the ETF down NT$1.21, a 9.95% drop, and it closed at the NT$10.95 limit down. Compared with Friday’s peak, the price fell nearly 13% in just two trading days, instantly trapping investors who bought at the high and sparking the default settlement storm.

Reviewing recent ETF default cases, the last large‑scale incident was on December 17, 2024, involving the Yuanta CSI 300 Positive‑2 ETF (00637L‑TW), where volatile Chinese stocks led the Nan‑Gang branch of Guo Piao Securities to report a default of NT$32,296,700. In October of the same year, the OTC market’s Yong‑Feng China Technology 50 ETF (00887‑TW) also defaulted, with a breach of NT$14,692,600 after premiums spiraled out of control.

The exchange cautions that leveraged and inverse ETFs have compounding effects and amplified volatility, often experiencing extreme premium/discount swings in turbulent markets. Investors engaging in short‑term day‑trading or swing trades should carefully assess their financial capacity and settlement fund levels, and avoid over‑extending credit to prevent default settlements, credit ruin, and legal liability.

items.title: 上詮自結10月EPS為0.07元 單月獲利已較Q3、去年同期虧轉盈
items.title_en: Ubiquiti (3363‑TW) posts October EPS of NT$0.07, monthly profit turns from loss to gain versus Q3 and same period last year
paras: 光通訊大廠上詮(3363-TW)近期因股價波動劇烈，遭主觀機關要求公告財務資訊，上詮今(24)日盤後自結上(10)月財報，稅後純益為800萬元，相較於去(2025)年同期由虧轉盈，單月EPS為0.07元，也較今(2026)年第3季稅後淨損0.06元相比為家，單月已較第3季累計由虧轉盈。
上詮今日自結10月營收，單月營收達2.29億元、年增71％，稅前淨利1,100萬元，稅後純益800萬元，單月獲利表現優於第3季整季，也優於今年前3季累計稅後每股淨損1.24元。
/法人指出，上詮第2季主因FAU(光纖陣列單元)啟動試產，才導致獲利表現不如意，第3季隨著機台陸續進場，良率也大幅提升，虧損逐步收斂，第4季將隨著3.2T FAU將持續放量，也搭上Scale-Out、Scale-Up皆採用CPO(矽光)趨勢，有望推升公司營收、獲利由虧轉盈。
此外，上詮另為了強化CPO產品量產布局，公司也持續建置FAU高精密自動化生產線，預計今年至明(2027)年第2季，將規劃投入資本支出建置產線，包括FAU生產機台，預計總資本支出預算總額約為33.3億元。
據了解，上詮新增資本支出，主要為了配合公司擴廠及擴充產能需求，以擴產切入FAU的光通訊市場，並迎接未來的AI基礎建設挑戰，搶先布局商機。
展望未來，上詮也持續與國內半導體客戶持續密切合作，雙方合作應用在COUPE先進封裝上，包括明(2027)年之後交付3.2T、6.4T的FAU產品，也為後續CPO產品出貨先做準備。
paras_en: Ubiquiti (3363‑TW), a major optical‑communication manufacturer, has recently faced volatile share prices and a regulatory request to disclose financial information. After market close on the 24th, the company released its self‑compiled October results, reporting a net profit after tax of NT$8 million. This marks a swing from a loss in the same month of 2025 to a profit, with an EPS of NT$0.07 for the month, and improves on the Q3 2026 net loss of NT$0.06 per share, turning the monthly result from a loss to a profit compared with the cumulative Q3 figure.

For October, Ubiquiti recorded revenue of NT$2.29 billion, up 71% year‑on‑year. Pre‑tax profit was NT$11 million and net profit after tax was NT$8 million. The monthly profit outperformed the entire Q3 and also beat the cumulative net loss per share of NT$1.24 recorded over the first three quarters of this year.

Analysts note that the weak Q2 performance was mainly due to the start of trial production of FAU (Fiber Array Units). In Q3, as more machines came online, yields improved dramatically, narrowing the losses. In Q4, the 3.2‑T FAU is expected to scale up further, and with both Scale‑Out and Scale‑Up adopting CPO (silicon photonics) technology, the company anticipates revenue and profit to shift from loss to gain.

To strengthen its CPO mass‑production capabilities, Ubiquiti is also building a high‑precision automated FAU production line. The company plans to invest capital expenditures through the second quarter of 2027 to set up the line, including FAU manufacturing equipment, with a total capex budget of approximately NT$3.33 billion.

The additional capex is aimed at supporting the company’s plant expansion and capacity increase to capture more of the FAU optical‑communication market and to meet future AI infrastructure demands, positioning the firm ahead of emerging business opportunities.

Looking ahead, Ubiquiti will continue close cooperation with domestic semiconductor customers on advanced COUPE packaging. Deliveries of 3.2‑T and 6.4‑T FAU products are slated for after 2027, also preparing the groundwork for subsequent CPO product shipments.

items.title: 聯發科建構邊緣AI到雲端AI完整技術版圖 今年17篇論文入選全球頂尖期刊及會議
items.title_en: MediaTek Builds Complete Edge‑AI to Cloud‑AI Technology Landscape; 17 Papers Selected for Top Global Journals and Conferences in 2026
paras: IC設計大廠聯發科(2454-TW)持續深化前瞻技術研發，今(24)日宣布，2026年共有17篇論文入選全球頂尖積體電路設計、AI與通訊領域國際學術會議及期刊，其中5篇將於2027年2月在國際固態電路研討會(ISSCC 2027)發表。聯發科也成為台灣唯一連續24年有論文入選ISSCC的企業，累計入選篇數達110篇。
聯發科指出，此次入選論文涵蓋ISSCC、JSSC、ICML、ECCV、NeurIPS、AAAI、DAC、TVLSI及IEEE Wireless Communications等國際頂尖會議與期刊，研究範圍包括邊緣AI、次世代通訊、AI資料中心及AI輔助晶片設計，展現從邊緣AI到雲端AI的技術布局。
在研究主題方面，聯發科集團旗下前瞻技術研發單位及人工智慧研究單位聯發創新基地(MediaTek Research)，研究成果涵蓋AI加速器、AI超高解析度顯示與夜景攝影、2奈米晶片設計與製程協同最佳化、低功耗高效能多核心CPU、高速SerDes介面、Wi-Fi 8射頻技術及6G通訊等，也包括運用AI強化晶片設計與自動化的相關技術，未來可望應用於邊緣運算、網通設備及AI資料中心等領域。
除了自主研發，聯發科也透過前瞻研發中心(MediaTek Advanced Research Center，MARC)深化產學合作，2026年與全球頂尖學術機構共同發表或贊助發表超過百篇論文，擴大前瞻研究能量並培育半導體與AI人才。
此外，聯發科專家也受邀擔任晶片設計、AI及6G領域國際學術會議與期刊的重要職務，持續參與全球學術研究及技術交流。聯發科2023年至2025年每年研發投入均超過1,000億元，持續布局關鍵技術，將研發成果轉化為產品與產業競爭力。
paras_en: MediaTek (2454‑TW), a major IC design company, continues to deepen its forward‑looking technology R&D and announced today (24th) that 17 papers were selected for top international conferences and journals in integrated circuit design, AI and communications for 2026. Five of these will be presented at the International Solid‑State Circuits Conference (ISSCC 2027) in February 2027. MediaTek also became the only Taiwanese company to have papers accepted at ISSCC for 24 consecutive years, bringing its cumulative total to 110 papers.

MediaTek noted that the selected papers span premier venues such as ISSCC, JSSC, ICML, ECCV, NeurIPS, AAAI, DAC, TVLSI and IEEE Wireless Communications. The research covers edge AI, next‑generation communications, AI data centers and AI‑assisted chip design, showcasing a technology roadmap from edge AI to cloud AI.

In terms of research topics, MediaTek’s forward‑looking technology unit and its AI research arm, the MediaTek Research Innovation Center, produced work on AI accelerators, ultra‑high‑resolution AI displays and night‑vision imaging, 2‑nm chip design and process‑co‑optimization, low‑power high‑performance multi‑core CPUs, high‑speed SerDes interfaces, Wi‑Fi 8 RF technology and 6G communications, as well as AI‑enhanced chip design and automation. These advances are expected to be applied in edge computing, networking equipment and AI data‑center domains.

Beyond in‑house development, MediaTek leverages its MediaTek Advanced Research Center (MARC) to deepen industry‑academia collaboration. In 2026 the company co‑authored or sponsored over a hundred papers with leading global academic institutions, expanding its forward‑looking research capacity and nurturing semiconductor and AI talent.

In addition, MediaTek experts were invited to serve in key roles for international conferences and journals in chip design, AI and 6G, continuously participating in global academic research and technology exchange. MediaTek’s R&D spending from 2023 to 2025 each year exceeded NT$100 billion, sustaining its focus on critical technologies and turning research outcomes into products and industry competitiveness.

items.title: 台股單日飆漲3310點仍有5檔個股明起抓去關 處置到12/1止
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks surge 3,310 points in a single day, but five stocks will be subject to disposition from tomorrow until Dec 1
paras: 台股今(24)日上演大奇蹟日反攻上揚，終場大漲3,310.46點，雖收歷史最大漲點，但據證交所、櫃買中心盤後公告，仍有5檔股票遭處置交易，包括廣寰科(3287-TW)、創意(3443-TW)、營邦(3693-TW)、大立(4716-TW)及GIS-KY(6456-TW)，自明(25)日起處置到下(12)月1日止，交易撮合時間皆為2分鐘。
其中集中市場中，創意處置原因：最近６個營業日累積收盤價跌幅達29.63%。且6個營業日起迄兩個營業日收盤價價差達1,345元。
GIS-KY處置原因：最近6個營業日累積收盤價跌幅達32.93%；且今日之周轉率為25.86%。
廣寰科處置原因：連續3個營業日達櫃買「公布注意交易資訊」標準，且最近30個營業日內曾發布處置。
營邦處置原因：最近6個營業日(含今日)累積之最後成交價跌幅達27.14%且最近6個營業日(含今日)起迄兩個營業日之最後成交價價差達新台幣101.5元。
大立處置原因：最近6個營業日(含今日)累積之最後成交價跌幅達30.88%；美商高盛亞證券公司當日受託賣出該有價證券之成交量占當日該有價證券總成交量之比率為20.9%。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market staged a remarkable rebound today (the 24th), closing up 3,310.46 points – the largest point gain on record. However, the exchange and the OTC market announced after hours that five stocks will be placed under disposition trading: Guanghuan Technology (3287‑TW), Creative (3443‑TW), Yingbang (3693‑TW), Dali (4716‑TW) and GIS‑KY (6456‑TW). The disposition will run from tomorrow (the 25th) through December 1, and each trading session will be limited to two minutes.

In the main market, the reason for Creative’s disposition is that over the most recent six trading days the cumulative closing‑price decline reached 29.63%, and the price difference between the closing price on the first day and that two trading days later amounted to NT$1,345.
The reason for GIS‑KY’s disposition is that over the most recent six trading days the cumulative closing‑price decline reached 32.93%, and today’s turnover rate was 25.86%.

The reason for Guanghuan Technology’s disposition is that it met the OTC market’s “notice of trading information” criteria for three consecutive trading days, and it had previously been placed under disposition within the past 30 trading days.

The reason for Yingbang’s disposition is that over the most recent six trading days (including today) the cumulative decline in the last transaction price reached 27.14%, and the price difference between the last transaction price on the first day and that two trading days later was NT$101.5.

The reason for Dali’s disposition is that over the most recent six trading days (including today) the cumulative decline in the last transaction price reached 30.88%; Goldman Sachs Asia Securities acted as an agent on the day, selling securities whose transaction volume accounted for 20.9% of the total daily volume of those securities.

items.title: 美股恐重演2018年暴跌？城堡證券示警：Fed升息、AI投資降溫形成雙重壓力
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks May Relive 2018 Crash? Citadel Securities Warns Dual Pressure from Fed Rate Hikes and Cooling AI Investment
paras: 城堡證券（Citadel Securities）策略師警告，金融市場正釋出經濟成長前景轉趨黯淡的訊號，而聯準會（Fed）的政策立場卻日益強硬。這種局面令人聯想到2018年底，當時類似的市場環境最終導致風險資產遭遇大幅拋售。
根據《彭博》報導，城堡證券宏觀策略主管Frank Flight在11月20日發布的一份報告中指出，當前市場背景與8年前頗為相似。當時美國經濟展現韌性，掩蓋了經濟前景正在惡化的事實，隨後疲弱態勢逐漸蔓延至各個市場。
Flight表示，與當年相同的是，目前美元走強、景氣循環股持續下跌，而決心維持緊縮貨幣政策的聯準會，也使債券殖利率維持在高檔。
交易員預期，聯準會下個月將升息以抑制通膨。過去3個月來，這項預期已對工業、原物料及能源等與經濟成長連動密切的類股造成壓力，直到周一市場大幅反彈才有所緩解。
Flight指出，兩個時期的共同點在於，美國例外論以及強韌的國內經濟活動，容易讓市場忽略未來成長前景正在轉弱的事實。當年的風險來自美中貿易戰，如今則是伊朗戰爭，這些因素都讓情況雪上加霜。
他也提醒，市場容易認為近期修正已充分反映經濟前景惡化，但2018年的經驗並未提供太多樂觀理由。
標普500指數周一終結連續7個交易日下跌的走勢，並在跌入修正區間後強勢反彈。輝達(NVDA-US) 周一宣布重新聘用黃仁勳擔任執行長，成為帶動市場反轉的重要因素。
不過，隨著投資人對人工智慧（AI）熱潮及聯準會可能升息的疑慮升高，標普500指數目前仍較10月初創下的收盤歷史高點低約7%。
2018年，聯準會同樣處於升息周期，時任主席鮑爾（Jerome Powell）曾表示，利率距離中性水準「還有很長一段距離」，引發市場不安。
到了同年12月，標普500指數已較9月高點下跌近20%。這波重挫促使投資人卓肯米勒（Stanley Druckenmiller）與華許（Kevin Warsh）呼籲聯準會暫停貨幣緊縮政策。
如今，5月接掌聯準會的華許也面臨類似的政策難題。聯準會9月睽違3年首度升息，並承諾加快讓通膨回到2%的目標。即使上周股市大幅下挫，仍有兩名聯準會官員重申，借貸成本需要進一步提高。
彭博策略師David Savage指出：「美國目前的局面令人聯想到2018年底，當時聯準會在12月升息之際，股市持續下跌，信用利差也開始擴大。」
城堡證券歐洲、中東及非洲（EMEA）固定收益銷售主管Nohshad Shah則表示，投資人不應認為「股市疲弱就能帶來貨幣政策寬鬆」。與2018年不同的是，目前核心通膨率一直維持在3%以上，明顯高於聯準會2%的通膨目標。
Shah在另一份報告中指出，當前風險在於，聯準會進一步收緊政策之際，支撐美國經濟成長的AI投資周期可能同步放緩。
他認為，隨著財政支持逐漸減弱、融資環境收緊，以及AI熱潮動能減退，美國經濟正進入一個「容錯空間更小」的階段。
Shah寫道：「這帶來一種令人不安的可能性：聯準會持續採取緊縮措施對抗通膨，但市場對未來經濟成長的預期卻不斷惡化。」
他並指出：「初期調整可能表現在殖利率曲線趨平，以及風險資產進一步承壓。」
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Citadel Securities strategists warn that financial markets are sending signals that economic growth prospects are dimming, while the Federal Reserve’s policy stance is becoming increasingly hawkish. This situation recalls the end of 2018, when a similar market environment ultimately led to a sharp sell‑off of risk assets.

According to Bloomberg, Citadel’s macro‑strategy head Frank Flight noted in a report released on November 20 that today’s market backdrop is quite similar to that of eight years ago. Back then, a resilient U.S. economy masked the fact that the outlook was deteriorating, and the weakness later spread across markets.
Flight said the parallels include a strong dollar, continued declines in cyclical stocks, and a Fed determined to keep monetary policy tight, which keeps bond yields elevated.

Traders expect the Fed to raise rates next month to curb inflation. Over the past three months this expectation has weighed on industrial, materials and energy stocks that are closely tied to growth, only easing after a sharp market rebound on Monday.

Flight pointed out that the common thread in both periods is the U.S. exception narrative and robust domestic activity, which make markets overlook the weakening growth outlook. The risk then came from the U.S.–China trade war; today it is the war in Iran, compounding the situation.
He also cautioned that markets may think the recent correction has fully priced in the worsening outlook, but the 2018 experience offered little reason for optimism.

The S&P 500 ended a seven‑day losing streak on Monday and rallied strongly after entering correction territory. Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced on Monday that Jensen Huang would return as CEO, becoming a key driver of the market reversal.
However, with investors’ concerns about the AI hype and the Fed’s possible rate hikes rising, the S&P 500 is still about 7% below the closing all‑time high set in early October.
In 2018 the Fed was also in a rate‑hiking cycle; then‑Chair Jerome Powell said rates were “still a long way from neutral,” sparking market unease.
By December that year, the S&P 500 had fallen nearly 20% from its September peak, prompting investors Stanley Druckenmiller and Kevin Warsh to call for a pause in monetary tightening.

Today, Kevin Warsh, who took over the Fed in May, faces a similar policy dilemma. The Fed raised rates in September for the first time in three years and pledged to accelerate the return of inflation to its 2% target. Even after last week’s sharp market drop, two Fed officials reiterated that borrowing costs need to rise further.

Bloomberg strategist David Savage said, “The current U.S. situation reminds us of the end of 2018, when the Fed raised rates in December while the stock market kept falling and credit spreads began to widen.”

Citadel’s EMEA fixed‑income sales head Nohshad Shah warned investors not to assume that “a weak equity market will lead to monetary easing.” Unlike 2018, core inflation now stays above 3%, clearly above the Fed’s 2% target.
In another note, Shah highlighted the current risk: as the Fed tightens further, the AI investment cycle that supports U.S. growth could slow simultaneously.
He believes that with fiscal support waning, financing conditions tightening, and AI momentum fading, the U.S. economy is entering a phase with a much smaller margin for error.
Shah wrote, “This creates an unsettling possibility: the Fed continues tightening to fight inflation while market expectations for future growth keep deteriorating.”
He added, “The early adjustment may show up as a flattening yield curve and further pressure on risk assets.”
This article is not available for partner re‑publication.

items.title: 華為在美國刑事案件中遭判有罪 涉伊朗業務及竊取商業機密
items.title_en: Huawei Convicted in U.S. Criminal Case Over Iran Business and Theft of Trade Secrets
paras: 《路透社》報導，中國電信設備製造商華為週二(24日)在美國一起重大刑事案件中遭判有罪，罪名包括在伊朗業務方面欺騙銀行，以及竊取美國企業的商業機密。
紐約布魯克林聯邦陪審團裁定，華為面臨的12項刑事指控中，有10項成立。陪審團則認定這家科技公司未涉及「共謀敲詐勒索罪」（racketeering conspiracy），該罪名指控華為以犯罪企業的形式運作。
華為在聲明中表示，遭判有罪的相關指控缺乏法律依據，並稱將「採取一切必要法律行動，捍衛公司的權利與利益」。
美國當局多年來持續針對華為，認為該公司對美國國家安全構成風險。
這起刑事案件始於2018年。隔年，美國政府將華為列入貿易黑名單，限制其取得美國技術。
不過，專家指出，這起案件並未因此削弱華為的業務。華為透過業務多元化，並在中國推動人工智慧發展的過程中崛起，成為重要參與者。
這場審判歷時兩個多月，檢方傳喚超過60名證人，辯方則傳喚15名證人。華為及其三家關係企業總共面臨12項指控，包括共謀敲詐勒索、銀行詐欺、電信詐欺、違反制裁規定，以及共謀竊取商業機密與妨礙司法公正等。
《路透社》在2012年及2013年刊出的報導，曾協助揭露華為在伊朗的業務活動，相關內容也在審判期間受到討論。
檢察官 Meredith Arfa 在結案陳詞時對陪審團表示，「媒體開始質疑華為在伊朗的業務後，華為往來的銀行也開始提出質疑。」

創辦人之女曾遭拘留

這起案件於2018年12月浮上檯面。當時華為財務長、創辦人之女孟晚舟在美國發出的逮捕令下，於加拿大遭到拘留，引發美國、中國與加拿大之間的外交危機。
孟晚舟當時已遭美國秘密起訴，罪名是向滙豐銀行一名銀行家隱瞞華為在伊朗的業務情況，使公司得以違反美國制裁規定，在伊朗進行美元資金收付。
她花了近三年時間對抗美國的引渡要求，之後與美方達成延後起訴協議，並返回中國，受到英雄式歡迎。美國隨後撤銷對她的指控。

檢方指控華為竊取商業機密

2018年的起訴書指控，華為在與伊朗的業務往來方面，向滙豐銀行、渣打銀行及法國巴黎銀行提供不實資訊。
檢方於2020年追加新的指控，指出華為在長達20年的期間內，涉嫌共謀竊取美國科技公司的商業機密。
審判期間，檢方試圖證明華為竊取思科系統（Cisco Systems）路由器的原始碼、竊取無線電信公司Quintel的天線技術，並聘用一名教授，以取得半導體公司CNEX開發的電路板。
陪審團觀看了一段影片。檢方表示，影片顯示一名華為員工將一塊T-Mobile測試機器人的零件偷偷放進背包。陪審團也聽取了一起事件的證詞：一名華為工程師曾在貿易展覽期間，偷偷進入富士通（Fujitsu）展位拍攝一台設備。
檢方還向陪審團出示孟晚舟延後起訴協議所附上的一份聲明。她在聲明中承認，華為曾在伊朗非法從事業務。孟晚舟並未在審判期間出庭作證，不過，她於2013年曾會面的滙豐銀行家出庭作證。

辯方稱銀行早已知悉華為在伊朗業務

辯方主張，滙豐銀行及其他銀行早已知道華為在伊朗的業務，而且這些銀行當時都積極爭取與華為合作。
華為律師 Brian Heberlig 在結案陳詞時，指責檢方刻意「挑選」少數彼此無關的事件，藉此支持華為涉及長達20年共謀行為的指控。
華為目前在全球約170個國家營運，員工人數超過20萬人。
paras_en: Reuters reported that Chinese telecom equipment maker Huawei was found guilty on Tuesday (the 24th) in a major U.S. criminal case, with charges including bank fraud related to its Iran business and theft of U.S. companies' trade secrets.

A federal jury in Brooklyn, New York, found ten of the twelve criminal counts against Huawei valid. The jury also concluded the firm was not involved in a racketeering conspiracy, which would have treated Huawei as a criminal enterprise.
Huawei said in a statement that the guilty findings lack legal basis and that it will "take all necessary legal action to defend the company's rights and interests."
U.S. authorities have pursued Huawei for years, deeming the company a national‑security risk.
The case dates back to 2018. The following year, the U.S. government placed Huawei on a trade blacklist, restricting its access to American technology.
Experts note the case has not weakened Huawei’s business; the firm has diversified its operations and risen as a key player in China’s AI development push.

The trial lasted more than two months, with prosecutors calling over 60 witnesses and the defense 15. Huawei and three affiliates faced twelve counts, including racketeering conspiracy, bank fraud, telecom fraud, sanctions violations, and conspiracy to steal trade secrets and obstruct justice.
Reuters reports from 2012 and 2013 helped expose Huawei’s activities in Iran, and that reporting was discussed during the trial.
Prosecutor Meredith Arfa told the jury in closing arguments that "once the media began questioning Huawei’s Iran business, the banks it dealt with also started raising concerns."

The case first surfaced in December 2018 when Huawei’s CFO and founder’s daughter, Meng Wanzhou, was detained in Canada on a U.S. arrest warrant, sparking a diplomatic crisis among the United States, China and Canada.
Meng was secretly indicted in the United States for allegedly concealing Huawei’s Iran dealings from a HSBC banker, enabling the company to violate U.S. sanctions and move dollar funds in Iran.
She spent nearly three years fighting U.S. extradition, later reaching a deferred‑prosecution agreement, returning to China to a hero’s welcome, after which the U.S. dropped the charges against her.
The 2018 indictment alleged Huawei gave false information to HSBC, Standard Chartered and BNP Paribas about its Iran business.
In 2020 prosecutors added new charges, alleging Huawei conspired over a 20‑year period to steal trade secrets from U.S. technology firms.

During the trial prosecutors tried to show Huawei stole Cisco Systems router source code, Qualcomm‑related antenna technology from Quintel, and hired a professor to obtain a circuit board developed by semiconductor firm CNEX.

The jury watched a video showing a Huawei employee slipping a component from a T‑Mobile test robot into a backpack, and heard testimony that a Huawei engineer secretly entered Fujitsu’s booth at a trade show to photograph equipment.

Prosecutors also presented a statement attached to Meng’s deferred‑prosecution agreement in which she acknowledged Huawei’s illegal Iran business; Meng did not testify, but a HSBC banker she met in 2013 did.
